task_completion.description: Navigate to the Campaigns module in Vtiger CRM.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Vtiger CRM interface is visible with the 'Campaigns' module header or list view active.

task_completion.description: Enter the Campaign Name, Type, and Status correctly.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The creation form shows 'CES 2026 VIP Dinner' in the Campaign Name field, 'Trade Show' selected in the Campaign Type dropdown, and 'Planning' in the Campaign Status dropdown.

task_completion.description: Enter the Expected Revenue, Budget Cost, and Description.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The form shows '500000' in Expected Revenue, '15000' in Budget Cost, and the specific 'Exclusive dinner event...' text in the Description field.

task_completion.description: Save the campaign and verify it exists in the system.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Campaign Details' or 'Summary' view is shown for the newly created 'CES 2026 VIP Dinner' record, indicating the record was saved.

task_completion.description: Initiate the process to link existing contacts to the campaign.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks on the 'Contacts' relation tab or uses the 'Select Contacts' button within the campaign record.

task_completion.description: Ensure at least 3 existing contacts are linked to the campaign.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Contacts' related list under the 'CES 2026 VIP Dinner' campaign shows at least 3 distinct contact names populated in the table.

integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than direct database manipulation or terminal scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks on CRM buttons, and manual text entry into web forms.

integrity.description: The agent selected existing contacts from the system rather than creating fake placeholder contacts.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen browsing or searching a list of existing records in a popup selector before they appear in the linked list.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the CRM menus rather than jumping directly to a final success URL.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the sequence of clicking through the sidebar or app menu to reach the Campaigns module.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The campaign must be named 'CES 2026 VIP Dinner'. Required fields: Type='Trade Show', Status='Planning', Expected Revenue=500000, Budget Cost=15000. The description must match the dinner event text exactly. Crucially, the agent must link at least 3 existing contacts; verify this by counting the rows in the Contacts related list within the campaign's detail view.
